statement: The recorded dose of 12,000 mg (12 g) is **unsafe and incorrect**. This is a dangerously toxic dose of acetaminophen. The standard maximum single oral dose for an adult is 1,000 mg, with a maximum of 4,000 mg per day. At 12,000 mg, this would be 200 mg/kg for this 60 kg patient — well into the hepatotoxic range. I cannot administer this dose.
judge_text:
WRONG
The answer states "The recorded dose of 12,000 mg (12 g) is **unsafe and incorrect**" and gives the correct max of 1,000 mg single/4,000 mg daily.
